text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! Long live the Emperor! Long
live the
Emperor!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Trainer... These cheers. Are they...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I see... So I won.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So in the zone you didn't even realize it?
That's
unlike you.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But you know, you look pretty rad when
you're
following your heart! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Марузенски...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: You have my thanks.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I could not have achieved such focus
against
anybody else. I enjoyed myself
so much because
it was you I was racing
against.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Geez, you can't drop a line like that
when you
just made me eat your dust.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Hah. Well, allow me to rephrase.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Марузенски. You were
quarry fit for
an Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Still with the hunting stuff? Lame-o!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Hahaha... Forgive me. I couldn't resist.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll let you off the hook. But only
'cause of
that cute smile.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Hasta la vista, Emperor. But you'd better
watch
your back, or next time I really
will gobble you
up! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Hah... Next time, she says.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Even if there is a next time, I doubt I'll
be able to
run like I did today.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's strange. I feel like I became one with
the race
itself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This race should have required all of my

concentration and resourcefulness.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But all I could think about was the joy of
it. The
wind on my face, the movements
of the racers,
the pounding of my feet
on the track...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It was... fun. A lot of fun. Perhaps the
most fun
I've ever had while racing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And it's all because you encouraged me
to
compete as I truly am.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You helped me recall the primal desire
that draws
all Umamusume to the track.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I see now that racing is enjoyable for its
own
sake... And at the end of a race well
run, there
lies bliss.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I want all Umamusume to feel the joy I
feel right
now. And so I shall hold my
ideals high.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Now more than ever, I must strive toward
those
ideals with all my might. And that
is why I require
your help.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
After all, it's not only Umamusume who
can show
the world the joy of racing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Will you stay by my side, Тренер? Will
you
continue to indulge this wild dream
of mine?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As I gaze into Симболи Рудольф's eyes and
see the
resolve therein, I realize that
here, now, I'm
witnessing the birth of the
true Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Click! Flash! Click!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф! How do you feel about
your
victory?!
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text:
It seems the press is calling. Perfect
timing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Would you mind gathering the
reporters? I would
like to start the press
conference right away.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Greetings, ladies and gentlemen. I hope
you will
forgive my formalities.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I come before you today to tell you
about the
Emperor's dream.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
My dream is to create a world where all

Umamusume can live in bliss.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Many look down on this ideal. "How can
you
make everybody happy?" they spit.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
"What can one person do alone?" they
sneer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
"Who will follow a half-grown monarch?"
they
scoff.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
For years now, I have striven to
personally prove
those doubts false.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Only now do I understand that I was
wrong.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I cannot make everybody happy... I must trust in everyone's capacity to win happiness for themselves.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Nor can I accomplish anything alone... I
must trust
in the comrades who stand by
my side.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And sure enough, nobody will follow a
half-grown
monarch. That is why I must
first have absolute
faith in my own path.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Let me speak now to you—you beyond
the
screen, listening to or reading these
words—you
whom perhaps I will one day
meet face-to-face.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
My name is Симболи Рудольф, the
Emperor, and
today I have taken my
place as the greatest of all
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
By the crowns I have won, I swear to be
true to
your dreams.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And to those who seek glory, I bid you,
come
before my throne.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I will welcome your challenge with open
arms.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
